title: failed to register application for bluetooth scan during reconnect to BlueJay watch
symptom: After the BlueJay watch was in range of the phone, no values were transferred to xDrip. A scan in the BlueJay Admin panel is not successful and prints the error 'Failed to register application for bluetooth scan' with BleScanException code 6. The issue occurs during reconnect after the watch has been out of range for a while.
cause: The Bluetooth of the Android phone has crashed, and a restart is often the only way to fix it. The issue is likely a problem with xDrip, as it worked previously and no OS updates were performed.
fix: Restarting the phone resolves the issue. Disabling and enabling Bluetooth allows the scan to work but does not restore data transfer. The maintainer suggests that a restart is often the only way to fix the crashed Bluetooth.
evidence_quote: This probably means the bluetooth of your android phone has crashed, a restart is often the only way to fix it.
